children.value: > Fact From Story As part of its search deal with Apple, Google agreed not to promote Chrome to Safari users, reports Bloomberg.
> > Fact From Story Google would have been able to do this with banners, pop-ups and other annoying means in other Google apps.
> > > Fact From Story The agreement also meant that Apple never switched to a Google competitor or allowed users to choose their browser when setting up their iPhones.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Companies usually promote their own products.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Banners and pop-ups are ways to promote products.
> Commonsense Knowledge Companies can promote their own products to users of other companies' products.
